channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50
item.guid: Subway-BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50-2026-10-13
item.description: Buy one footlong online or in the Subway app and get a second 50% off with code BOGO50 at participating locations. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026; the code has run since summer and may end without notice, so enter it before paying. (Limited time)

item.title: Tijuana Flats: Taco Tuesdaze: 2 Tacos + Chips + Drink for $7.99
item.guid: Tijuana Flats-Taco Tuesdaze: 2 Tacos + Chips + Drink f-2026-10-13
item.description: Every Tuesday at participating locations: two tacos, chips, and a drink for $7.99 in-store, online, or in the app - no third-party delivery, and pricing varies slightly by location. (FL & Southeast only) (Tuesdays only)

item.title: Smoothie King: Chicken Flatbread & Smoothie Bundle from $9.99
item.description: Pair any protein packed Chicken Flatbread with a 20oz Fruit Classic Smoothie for one bundled price, official site confirms pricing may vary by location. (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bo-2026-10-13
item.description: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Dierbergs: Sushi Tuesday: Select Rolls for $6
item.description: Every Tuesday, Dierbergs sells select varieties of its hand-rolled Bento sushi for $6 each (regularly $8 to $10). In store, no card or app needed, while supplies last. (St. Louis area only) (Tuesdays only)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-13
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: $7+ Meal Menu, including Fish & Chips for $7.99
item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-$7+ Meal Menu, including Fish & Chip-2026-10-13
item.description: Rubio's standing value menu runs meals from $7 to $10, headlined by Fish & Chips for $7.99, every day at participating locations. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: WaBa Grill: Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and drink for $7.99
item.guid: WaBa Grill-Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and dr-2026-10-13
item.description: A permanent value item: a mini bowl with chicken, sweet and spicy chicken or tofu, plus a value side and a 12 oz drink for $7.99, every day at participating locations. (CA & AZ only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-13
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Panera: Mix & Match: Half Sandwiches, Half Salads and Cups of Soup for $4.99 Each (2 or More)
item.guid: Panera-Mix & Match: Half Sandwiches, Half S-2026-10-13
item.description: Panera's value menu, launched February 2026: pick any two or more of about ten items (half sandwiches such as the Toasted Italiano, half salads such as the Fuji Apple Chicken, cups of soup such as Creamy Tomato) for $4.99 each, with a free side of baguette, chips or an apple. Two items make a $9.98 meal; no code or account needed. Prices vary by market. (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: Delicious Duos from $9.95: Small Entree, Protein and a Side, All Day
item.guid: Noodles & Company-Delicious Duos from $9.95: Small Entree,-2026-10-13
item.description: Noodles & Company's everyday combo, launched July 2025: a small entree with a duo-sized protein and a side from $9.95 ($10.95 for the chef-curated noodles and macs), served all day with no code or account. Prices vary by location. (Ongoing)

item.title: Saladworks: Tuesday Deal: Build-Your-Own Salad or Wrap for $6.99
item.guid: Saladworks-Tuesday Deal: Build-Your-Own Salad or Wr-2026-10-13
item.description: Every Tuesday, a build-your-own base salad or wrap is $6.99 at participating Saladworks locations. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026; check your location before you go. (Northeast & Mid-Atlantic only) (Tuesdays only)

item.title: Island Fin Poke: Topping Tuesday: Free Premium Topping with Any Bowl
item.guid: Island Fin Poke-Topping Tuesday: Free Premium Topping wi-2026-10-13
item.description: Every Tuesday, pick one premium topping (avocado, kimchi, masago, surimi and more, normally an upcharge) free with any poke bowl. Ask at the counter; no app, code or account needed. (FL & Select states only) (Tuesdays only)
